content:
sam: Heads up — I'm seeing a 15-30% tail latency bump on host preparse after the kernel-selector rollout. Noticed around 11:04 PT.

maya: saw that too on canary. flamegraph shows a lot more memcpy time in the tokenization path.

zara: I reproduced locally. perf top + strace show memcpy + smallwrite churn during streaming chunk assembly.

sam: snippet from perf (top few entries):
```
memcpy                34.2%
parse_tokens          18.1%
grpc_read              5.6%
kv_cache_lookup        4.8%
```

alex: that's odd — kernel selector flip should only change compute kernels, not add copies. could be quant-path doing copy-out of activations to align for SIMD?

ci-bot: canary-deploy-2026-03-22: completed step 3 -> traffic ramp to 20% (rolled-back: false)

maya: confirmed: selector picks a quantized kernel that expects contiguous buffer and we currently copy fragments into that buffer. previous kernel accepted scatter buffers.

zara: quick repro command I used (seq len 512, concurrency 50): `wrk -t8 -c50 -d60s "http://canary-host/api/generate?seq=512"` — run that with tracing enabled.

sam: any quick mitigations?

maya: toggling `pretoken_inplace=true` in the proxy shim removed the extra memcpy for me — p99 dropped ~12%.

alex: suggests a low-cost heuristic: prefer inplace-friendly kernels for requests with short seqs or small fragment counts. if request looks like fragmented streaming with many small frames, prefer the scatter-friendly kernel.

sam: propose: gate kernel selection with a simple rule: if token_count < 256 OR total_payload_bytes < 8k -> choose inplace kernel; else choose scatter kernel. Also expose env flag for testing.

zara: also found grpc smallwrite spikes — header slicing + many smallwrites causing syscall overhead during stream chunking. Patch to coalesce writev in proxy helped.

maya: micro-bench numbers from my run (canary -> patch branch):
```
before: p50 35ms, p95 220ms, p99 450ms
after:  p50 31ms, p95 190ms, p99 392ms
```

alex: nice. still want deeper KV-cache telemetry: are hits causing extra buffer copies when we rehydrate prefix? Maybe double-copy on cache miss path.

sam: action items: 1) add gating heuristic to kernel selector (alex) 2) add lightweight tracing around memcpy/chunk coalesce points (maya) 3) coalesce smallwrites in proxy (zara) 4) 24h canary with perf counters & p99 alerts (sam)

alex: I'm opening a small PR for the selector heuristic + unit test for boundary cases. tagging @maya for perf review. :+1:

maya: ack. will run extended repro overnight and post flamegraphs + pprof link in this thread tomorrow morning.

sam: thanks. if anyone sees regressions in staging, ping me and I'll pause the rollout.

zara: FYI I've cherry-picked a writev coalesce patch to staging; monitoring now. :eyes:

sam: great work team — liking the short heuristic approach for now, we can revisit with more telemetry.
